name: 1948 Pontiac
description: The 1948 Pontiac is about pure, post-war grandeur. As one of the last "fat-fendered" designs before the automotive world shifted to the sleek, slab-sided looks of the 50s, the '48 Pontiac offers a chauffeur experience that feels like stepping directly into a classic Noir film or a high-society garden party.

name: 1964 Chevrolet Impala (POA)
description: The 1964 Chevrolet Impala is the gold standard for vintage chauffeur experiences, offering a seamless blend of mid-century "Jet Age" style and surprisingly plush comfort. Known for its iconic low-slung silhouette and signature triple taillights, it’s a vehicle that commands attention the moment it pulls up to a curb.

name: 1975 Chevrolet Caprice Classic (POA)
description: The 1975 Chevrolet Caprice Classic represents the absolute pinnacle of the "Land Yacht" era. If you are looking for a chauffeur experience defined by sheer scale, soft suspension, and unapologetic 70s decadence, this is the vessel. This was the year the Caprice truly earned its reputation as the "working man's Cadillac."

name: 2024 Mercedes Benz v300d (7 seater)
description: The Mercedes-Benz V300d is a refined luxury van that blends executive comfort with effortless practicality. With its sleek black exterior, spacious premium cabin, smooth 9-speed automatic drive, and strong diesel performance, it offers a sophisticated travel experience ideal for VIP transfers, family journeys, airport arrivals, and chauffeur-style occasions where comfort, presence, and elegance matter.

name: Audi R8 Spyder V10
description: The Audi R8 V10 is an iconic supercar that blends surgical precision, avant-garde styling, and cutting-edge technology. With its unmistakable mid-engine silhouette, gaping honeycomb grille, and striking laser-light signature, the R8 V10 commands attention through sophisticated aggression rather than sheer volume. The sharp, sculpted body lines and low-slung stance emphasize its racing-derived DNA, while signature elements like the carbon fiber side blades pay homage to Audi’s dominant heritage.

name: Audi R8 Spyder V10+
description: The Audi R8 V10 is an iconic supercar that blends surgical precision, avant-garde styling, and cutting-edge technology. With its unmistakable mid-engine silhouette, gaping honeycomb grille, and striking laser-light signature, the R8 V10 commands attention through sophisticated aggression rather than sheer volume. The sharp, sculpted body lines and low-slung stance emphasize its racing-derived DNA, while signature elements like the carbon fiber side blades pay homage to Audi’s dominant heritage.

name: BMW G87 M2 (Chauffeur)
description: The BMW G87 M2 is a compact performance icon that blends raw power, aggressive styling, and everyday usability. With its unmistakable wide stance, bold kidney grille, muscular wheel arches, and sharp LED light signature, the G87 M2 commands attention through confident athleticism and modern BMW aggression. Its sculpted body lines, short overhangs, and low, planted profile emphasize its track-inspired character, while signature M details and performance-focused design elements pay tribute to BMW’s legendary motorsport heritage.

name: BMW i8 Protonic - Limited Edition
description: The BMW i8 Protonic Limited Edition is a visionary plug-in hybrid sports car that blends futuristic innovation, aerodynamic artistry, and sustainable performance. With its unmistakable low-slung silhouette, dramatic dihedral "butterfly" doors, and striking U-shaped LED lighting, the i8 Protonic Edition commands attention as a masterpiece of modern engineering. The sculpted carbon-fiber body and layered surfaces emphasize its avant-garde design, while the exclusive Protonic paint finishes and bespoke interior accents pay homage to BMW’s pioneering role in the evolution of the electric supercar.
features: Aggressive aerodynamics such as air intakes built into the wings

name: BMW M4 Competition
description: The BMW M4 Competition is a high-performance coupe that blends muscular design, track-focused engineering, and everyday luxury. With its unmistakable wide stance, bold kidney grille, aggressive front bumper, and sharp LED light signature, the M4 Competition commands attention with confidence and purpose. Its sculpted body lines, flared arches, carbon-fibre accents, and low-slung profile highlight its motorsport-inspired DNA, while signature M details pay tribute to BMW’s rich performance heritage.

name: BMW M4 Competition
description: The BMW M4 Competition is a high-performance coupe that blends muscular design, track-focused engineering, and everyday luxury. With its unmistakable wide stance, bold kidney grille, aggressive front bumper, and sharp LED light signature, the M4 Competition commands attention with confidence and purpose. Its sculpted body lines, flared arches, carbon-fibre accents, and low-slung profile highlight its motorsport-inspired DNA, while signature M details pay tribute to BMW’s rich performance heritage.

name: BMW XM (Chauffeured)
description: The BMW XM is an iconic high-performance SUV that blends commanding presence, avant-garde styling, and cutting-edge electrified technology. With its unmistakable, muscular silhouette, gaping illuminated kidney grilles, and striking split-headlight signature, the XM commands attention through sophisticated aggression and sheer, unapologetic volume. The sharp, sculpted body lines and imposing, geometric stance emphasize its track-derived M DNA, while signature elements like the continuous gold accent band and stacked quad-exhaust tips pay homage to BMW’s rich heritage of high-performance engineering.

name: BMW Z4 M40i – Black (POA)
description: The BMW Z4 M40i in black is a sleek, high-performance roadster that perfectly balances luxury and sportiness. With its low, aggressive stance and long hood, it embodies the classic roadster silhouette while exuding modern elegance. The black paint adds a bold, stealthy look, complementing the car's aerodynamic curves and sharp lines.
features: Powered soft top that opens/closes in ~10 seconds

name: BMW Z4 M40i – Red (POA)
description: The BMW Z4 M40i in red is an eye-catching, high-performance roadster that merges bold styling with dynamic engineering. Its low-slung, wide stance, long hood, and sharp lines are accentuated by the vibrant red exterior, making it a striking presence on the road. The bright red colour exudes excitement and passion, perfectly complementing the Z4's sporty yet refined design.
features: Powered soft top that opens/closes in ~10 seconds

name: Chevrolet Deluxe Cream (POA)
description: The Chevrolet Deluxe, specifically in the iconic Cream (often called Mayland Ivory or Moonlite Cream), is the quintessential choice for a chauffeur experience that feels romantic, breezy, and timelessly optimistic. Produced in the late 40s and early 50s, the Deluxe was the "everything" car of post-war America, but in a chauffeur context, it radiates a "Golden Age of Hollywood" charm.

name: Ferrari California
description: The Ferrari California isn't just a car; it’s a grand-touring masterpiece that fuses Italian elegance with track-bred performance. Its sleek, aerodynamic silhouette and signature front-engine proportions ensure it commands the road, while the iconic prancing horse emblem serves as a glowing nod to its storied racing heritage. Every sculpted curve and retractable hardtop line screams sophistication, making it an unmistakable icon of the modern dolce vita.

name: Ford Mustang 5.0 GT Red Convertible
description: The Ford Mustang 5.0 GT isn't just a car; it’s a high-octane legend that fuses old-school muscle with cutting-edge tech. Its signature fastback shape and menacing grille ensure it dominates the road, while the classic tri-bar LEDs serve as a glowing nod to its storied past. Every sculpted curve and aggressive line screams performance, making it an unmistakable icon for the modern era.
features: Fully powered insulated fabric convertible top
Full LED headlamps with signature lighting
Long hood and Short rear deck with iconic pony branding

name: Ford Mustang 5.0 GT Silver Convertible
description: The Ford Mustang 5.0 GT is an iconic muscle car that blends raw power, aggressive styling, and modern technology. With its unmistakable fastback silhouette, bold front grille, and striking LED lighting, the Mustang 5.0 GT commands attention wherever it goes. The sculpted lines and muscular stance emphasize its performance-oriented design, while classic elements like the tri-bar taillights pay homage to Mustang's rich heritage.
features: Fully powered insulated fabric convertible top
Full LED headlamps with signature lighting
Long hood and Short rear deck with iconic pony branding

name: Ford Mustang Dark Horse (Chauffeured)
description: The Ford Mustang Dark Horse isn’t just a car; it’s a bold statement of performance. Powered by a naturally aspirated 5.0L V8, it combines iconic Mustang heritage with track-focused engineering. Its aggressive styling, unique Dark Horse design elements, and signature tri-bar LED lights create an unmistakable presence, while every detail is built to deliver an exhilarating driving experience on both road and track.

name: Ford Mustang GT 5.0 (Red)
description: The Ford Mustang GT 5.0 is an iconic American muscle car that blends raw power with modern refinement. Powered by a 5.0-liter V8 engine producing exhilarating performance, it rockets from 0 to 100 km/h in around 4.5 seconds and reaches a top speed of over 250 km/h. Its aggressive design, roaring exhaust note, and precise handling deliver an unmatched driving thrill, while the refined interior ensures comfort for every journey. Combining heritage, performance, and style, the Mustang GT 5.0 stands as a true symbol of driving passion.
features: Signature horse logo on the grille
Striking red paint paired with bold white stripes

name: Ford Mustang GT 5.0 Fastback (Chauffered)
description: The Ford Mustang GT 5.0 Fastback is a bold American muscle car with aggressive styling, a powerful Coyote V8 engine, and a striking blue finish that makes it stand out instantly. With its wide stance, sharp LED headlights, black performance details, and Shelby-inspired body styling, it delivers a strong mix of raw power, presence, and modern performance appeal.

name: Ford Mustang GT Convertible
description: The Ford Mustang 5.0 GT is a high-octane legend where classic muscle meets modern tech. With its aggressive fastback silhouette, menacing grille, and signature tri-bar LEDs, it commands the road while honoring its iconic heritage. Every sharp line and sculpted curve is engineered for performance, cementing its status as a modern-day icon.

name: Ford Mustang GT Silver
description: The Ford Mustang 5.0 GT blends raw American muscle with modern performance and unmistakable road presence. Its aggressive stance, bold front grille, sculpted bodywork, and iconic tri-bar lighting give it a look that is instantly recognisable. Powered by its legendary 5.0-litre V8, the Mustang delivers the sound, power, and character that have made it an icon for generations—now refined for the modern road.

name: Jaguar F-Type 2017
description: The 2017 V6 Jaguar F-Type S is a true British performance icon, blending elegant design, sharp handling, and thrilling supercharged power. With its long sculpted bonnet, low aggressive stance, signature LED lighting, and muscular rear haunches, the F-Type S delivers a bold and unmistakable road presence. Its sleek body lines, sporty proportions, and driver-focused character highlight Jaguar’s racing heritage, while the supercharged V6 engine gives it a raw, emotional driving experience with a distinctive exhaust note that makes every journey feel special.

name: Lamborghini Huracan
description: Driving the Lamborghini Huracán is a pure sensory rush defined by the unmistakable howl of its naturally aspirated V10 engine. From the moment you flip open the red starter cover, razor-sharp steering and instantaneous throttle response connect you directly to the road. With lightning-fast shifts and explosive acceleration past 8,000 RPM, the Huracán turns every drive into an unforgettable, heart-pounding event.

name: Maserati Grancabrio Sport (Chauffeured)
description: The Maserati GranCabrio Sport is an iconic Italian luxury convertible that blends raw power with modern refinement. Its potent 4.7-liter V8 engine provides exhilarating performance, rocketing from 0 to 100 km/h in just 5 seconds with a top speed over 285 km/h. With an aggressive design, precise handling, and a luxurious interior featuring fine leathers and carbon fiber, it offers an unmatched driving thrill. A true symbol of driving passion, the GranCabrio Sport perfectly combines heritage, performance, and exquisite grand touring style.

name: Mclaren 650s
description: The McLaren 650S is an iconic supercar that fuses razor-sharp performance with futuristic design and advanced engineering. With its unmistakable mid-engine layout, flowing aerodynamic curves, and signature LED headlight design inspired by the McLaren P1, the 650S commands attention through purposeful elegance rather than excess. Its sculpted bodywork is shaped by aerodynamics, featuring dramatic air intakes and a low, aggressive stance that highlights its racing pedigree. Signature elements like the dihedral doors and carbon fiber MonoCell chassis pay tribute to McLaren’s Formula 1 heritage, delivering a machine that feels both precision-built and visually striking.

name: McLaren MP4-12C
description: The McLaren MP4-12C isn't just a car; it’s a precision-engineered marvel that fuses Formula 1 DNA with revolutionary road-going tech. Its minimalist, wind-swept silhouette and signature dihedral doors ensure it dominates the asphalt, while the sleek LED light signatures serve as a glowing nod to McLaren’s pursuit of aerodynamic perfection. Every carbon-fiber contour and functional vent screams performance, making it an unmistakable icon of the modern supercar era.

name: McLaren MP4-12C (Chauffeured)
description: The McLaren MP4-12C in Orange is a striking, precision-engineered masterpiece that radiates high-octane energy and technical sophistication. Its low-slung, aerodynamic profile and signature dihedral doors embody a functional beauty that prioritizes speed and structural perfection. The vibrant orange finish serves as a bold homage to McLaren’s storied racing heritage, making the car’s fluid curves and sharp carbon-fiber accents pop with dramatic intensity. Every line of its sleek bodywork is designed for peak performance, ensuring that this supercar commands attention as a high-performance icon that is as visually electrifying as it is mechanically advanced.

name: Mercedes G-Wagon (Matric Package)
description: The Mercedes-Benz G 350d is a refined luxury SUV that combines iconic design with effortless performance and everyday practicality. Powered by a smooth 3.0-liter turbo diesel engine, it delivers strong torque for both city driving and off-road capability, while its bold, boxy presence ensures it stands out anywhere. Inside, premium materials and advanced technology provide exceptional comfort, making the G 350d a perfect balance of durability, sophistication, and versatility.

name: Mercedes G63 G Wagon
description: The Mercedes-AMG G63 is an iconic luxury SUV that fuses legendary off-road heritage with breathtaking performance. Beneath its unmistakable boxy silhouette lies a handcrafted 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8, unleashing immense power that propels it from 0 to 100 km/h in just 4.5 seconds and on to a top speed of around 240 km/h. Its bold design, commanding road presence, and signature AMG exhaust growl make every drive an event, while the opulent interior offers cutting-edge technology, premium materials, and supreme comfort. Combining exclusivity, capability, and performance, the G63 stands as the ultimate expression of luxury and power.

name: Mercedes GLC 43 AMG
description: The Mercedes-AMG GLC 43 is an iconic performance SUV that blends athletic precision, progressive styling, and intelligent technology. With its unmistakable fastback-inspired silhouette, gaping Panamericana grille, and striking LED headlamp signature, the GLC 43 commands attention through modern luxury rather than sheer bulk. The sharp, aero-sculpted body lines and poised, muscular stance emphasize its Affalterbach-derived DNA, while signature elements like the quad-exit exhausts and AMG badging pay homage to Mercedes’ dominant racing heritage.

name: Mercedes GLE 400d
description: The Mercedes-Benz GLE 400d is a luxurious SUV that masterfully combines commanding performance with premium comfort. Equipped with a powerful 3.0-liter inline-six turbo-diesel engine, it delivers strong torque for effortless acceleration, surging from 0 to 100 km/h in just under 5.7 seconds and reaching a top speed of around 245 km/h. Its muscular yet elegant design exudes confidence, while the refined cabin is crafted with high-quality materials, advanced technology, and exceptional comfort. Blending versatility, performance, and sophistication, the GLE 400d stands as a true statement of modern luxury on every journey.

name: Mercedes ML350
description: The Mercedes ML350 is a refined luxury SUV designed to deliver a perfect balance of performance, comfort, and versatility. Equipped with a 3.5-liter V6 petrol engine producing 350 Nm of torque, it offers smooth and confident power delivery. Accelerating from 0 to 100 km/h in approximately 8.4 seconds and reaching a top speed of 215 km/h, the ML350 ensures a dynamic yet composed driving experience. Its 7-speed automatic transmission provides seamless gear shifts, enhancing both efficiency and driving pleasure. With a spacious 5-seat, 5-door configuration, the ML350 combines practicality with the premium craftsmanship and advanced technology expected from Mercedes-Benz, making it an excellent choice for families and adventurers alike.

name: Mercedes V250
description: The Mercedes V250 is a premium multi-purpose vehicle (MPV) that offers a seamless blend of versatility, comfort, and efficiency. Powered by a 2.0-liter 4-cylinder turbocharged diesel engine, it delivers 140 kW (188 hp) and 440 Nm of torque, providing smooth and reliable performance. With acceleration from 0 to 100 km/h in approximately 9.5 seconds and a top speed of 210 km/h, the V250 ensures a comfortable yet dynamic driving experience. Its 9-speed automatic transmission enhances fuel efficiency and driving refinement, while the spacious 7-seat, 5-door configuration makes it ideal for families or executive transport. Combining practicality, advanced technology, and luxurious interior finishes, the Mercedes V250 is the perfect companion for both business and leisure.

name: Mercedes-AMG E63 S
description: The Mercedes-AMG E63 S is a luxury performance sedan that masterfully combines breathtaking power with refined sophistication. Powered by a 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 engine producing 450 kW (603 hp) and 850 Nm of torque, it accelerates from 0 to 100 km/h in just 3.4 seconds, with a top speed electronically limited to 250 km/h. Its 9-speed automatic transmission and 4MATIC+ all-wheel-drive system ensure seamless power delivery and exceptional handling. With a spacious 5-seat, 4-door configuration, it blends everyday practicality with cutting-edge technology and premium craftsmanship. The E63 S is the ultimate choice for those seeking unrelenting performance, head-turning design, and unmatched luxury.

name: Mercedes-Benz CLS 400d
description: The Mercedes-Benz CLS 400d is a sleek luxury coupe that combines elegance with dynamic performance. Its powerful 3.0L turbo-diesel engine delivers effortless power while maintaining refined comfort for executive travel.

name: Porsche 911 Carrera 4S
description: Blending understated grace with explosive capability, the Carrera 4S stands as a highlight of the 911 range. Its heart delivers a thrilling symphony of speed, making it the ideal choice for those who demand both style and substance.

name: Porsche Boxster (Chauffeur driven)
description: The Porsche Boxster is an iconic open-top sports car that blends timeless design, balanced performance, and classic Porsche driving purity. With its unmistakable low-slung silhouette, sculpted front end, and clean roadster proportions, the Boxster commands attention through refined athleticism rather than excessive aggression. Its sharp body lines, mid-engine layout, and planted stance emphasize Porsche’s performance-focused DNA, while signature elements like the rounded headlights, compact rear profile, and central exhaust outlet pay homage to the brand’s rich heritage of lightweight, driver-focused sports cars.

name: Porsche Boxster 718 S Blue
description: The Porsche 718 Boxster S is a refined mid-engine roadster that blends precision engineering with open-top exhilaration. Powered by a turbocharged 2.5-liter flat-four engine, it delivers sharp, immediate power — sprinting from 0 to 100 km/h in about 4.2 seconds and reaching a top speed of roughly 285 km/h. Its balanced mid-engine layout, razor-sharp steering, and responsive chassis provide exceptional handling confidence, whether carving mountain roads or cruising the coastline with the roof down.

name: Porsche Boxster 718 S White
description: The Porsche 718 Boxster S is a refined mid-engine roadster that blends precision engineering with open-top exhilaration. Powered by a turbocharged 2.5-liter flat-four engine, it delivers sharp, immediate power — sprinting from 0 to 100 km/h in about 4.2 seconds and reaching a top speed of roughly 285 km/h. Its balanced mid-engine layout, razor-sharp steering, and responsive chassis provide exceptional handling confidence, whether carving mountain roads or cruising the coastline with the roof down.

name: Porsche Boxster 718 S Yellow
description: The Porsche 718 Boxster S is a refined mid-engine roadster that blends precision engineering with open-top exhilaration. Powered by a turbocharged 2.5-liter flat-four engine, it delivers sharp, immediate power — sprinting from 0 to 100 km/h in about 4.2 seconds and reaching a top speed of roughly 285 km/h. Its balanced mid-engine layout, razor-sharp steering, and responsive chassis provide exceptional handling confidence, whether carving mountain roads or cruising the coastline with the roof down.

name: Porsche Boxster Trio
description:
Three stunning Porsche Boxsters. Blue, Yellow and White. One unforgettable experience.
Cruise through Cape Town together, from the scenic roads of Chapman's Peak to the breathtaking Cape Winelands.
Perfect for friends, special occasions or an exclusive luxury driving experience with all three Porsches.

name: Porsche Cayman
description: The Porsche Cayman is a mid-engine roadster with precision engineering and open-top exhilaration. Its perfectly balanced chassis and turbocharged flat-four engine deliver an unforgettable driving experience along Cape Town's coastal roads.

name: Porsche Macan GTS
description: The Porsche Macan GTS is a refined performance SUV that blends everyday practicality with unmistakable Porsche sportiness. Its twin-turbo V6 delivers thrilling acceleration while offering versatile space for passengers and luggage.

name: Porsche Macan S
description: The Porsche Macan S is a refined performance SUV that blends everyday practicality with unmistakable Porsche sportiness. Its twin-turbo V6 delivers thrilling acceleration while offering versatile space for passengers and luggage.

name: Suzuki Jimny
description: The Suzuki Jimny is a compact, retro-styled three-door off-roader that pairs a rugged ladder-frame chassis with a part-time 4WD system and a low-range transfer case for exceptional mechanical capability on tough terrain. Powered by a fuel-efficient 1.5-litre four-cylinder engine, its boxy design, tight turning circle, and outstanding ground clearance make it incredibly nimble both on technical trails and in tight city streets. While its minimalist interior prioritizes function over luxury, it includes modern infotainment essentials like smartphone integration alongside practical driver assists for hill climbing and descent.

name: Toyota Fortuner GD6 2025
description: The 2025 Toyota Fortuner GD-6 is a versatile powerhouse that seamlessly blends sophisticated urban styling with the "unbreakable" DNA of its off-road heritage. Its commanding presence is defined by a sharp, catamaran-inspired front fascia, sleek bi-tone aesthetics, and piercing LED signature lighting, all riding on a high-clearance chassis built for serious adventure. Merging modern refinement with rugged utility, the Fortuner features a premium seven-seater cabin and advanced 48V mild-hybrid technology, ensuring that whether you're navigating city boulevards or untamed trails, you do so with a perfect balance of efficiency and unyielding capability.

name: Toyota Land Cruiser Prado
description: The Toyota Land Cruiser Prado is an iconic off-roader that blends unyielding durability, purposeful styling, and go-anywhere technology. With its unmistakable high-clearance silhouette, imposing vertical-bar grille, and striking signature LED lighting, the Prado commands attention through rugged capability rather than sheer flashiness. The bold, boxy body lines and wide-track stance emphasize its expedition-derived DNA, while signature elements like the robust wheel arches and rear-mounted spare pay homage to Toyota’s dominant off-road heritage.
